description: Connecticut Fire Department Incidents (2012-2022) is published by National Fire Incident Reporting System (NFIRS). The extract reports fire-department incidents submitted to NFIRS, including rescue and false alarms. Its stated coverage is Connecticut, United States; annual incident records for 2012 to 2022. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. The provider warns that record counts vary substantially across years. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
